buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-qualification Criteria: 1) Past work experience: 1.0 TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE CRITERIA: (Required to be demonstrated in the submitted work order with proof of execution) Bidder must have successfully executed / completed during the last seven (7) years from the date of publi cation of the tender, a contract /work order involving: Erection / Installation of equipment / machineries, fabrication and erection / laying of Piping works in Mater ial of Construction as Carbon Steel / Alloy Steel / Stainless Steel in Industries type as Power Plants / Steel Pl ants / Hydrocarbon Sector (Petrochemicals complex / Refineries / Natural Gas Processing Plant / Fertilizer P lant) 2.0 VALUE-BASED EXPERIENCE CRITERIA: The bidder must have successfully executed / completed any one of the following works during the previou s seven (7) years: i) One successfully completed work order costing not less than Rs 6.69 Crores (excl. GST) OR ii) Two successfully completed work orders costing not less than Rs 4.18 Crores (excl. GST) OR iii) Three successfully completed work orders costing not less than Rs 3.34 Crores (excl. GST)

The above-mentioned Value-Based Experience Criteria shall be considered only for those work orders that successfully satisfy/fulfil the requirements of 1.0 TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE CRITERIA. NOTE FOR TECHNICAL BEC: A) The submitted work orders shall fulfill the Technical Pre-qualification criteria as mentioned in 1.0 TECHN ICAL EXPERIENCE CRITERIA as above. B) To meet the above criteria bidder shall submit notarized / self-attested relevant supporting documents s uch as copies of work order, Letter of Acceptance (LOA) (along with amendments issued, if any) issued and executed within the last 7 years ending the last day of month previous to the one in which this subject ten der is floated/issued with scope of supply, scope of work and technical specifications. Bidder to submit Co mpletion certificate / execution certificate (duly signed & stamped) issued by owner / consultant furnishing details of above required experience along with the bid. C) Valid documents to be submitted as proof of completion include a completion certificate issued by the p lant owner or the plant owner’s consultant, tax invoices against the submitted work order for the executed works, payment advices against the submitted work order for the executed works, or any other document establishing proof of execution. D) If the bidder is unable to provide the Completion certificate, the bidder shall furnish details of the end us er like name of the contact person of the end user with contact details such as Phone No., Email ID., etc. M /s RCF may contact the end user for getting the required documents or for confirmation of the execution a gainst the submitted work order. Bidder to note that their bid shall be rejected if the end user doesn't give RCF any confirmation regarding execution of the work against the submitted work order. Note: Such requests shall be made a maximum of two times, including one reminder, with the reminder be ing issued after three (03) days from the initial request E) Job executed by the bidder through an EPC Contractor in the above-mentioned Industry type of Industry type as Hydrocarbon Sector (Petrochemicals complex / Refineries / Natural Gas Processing Plant / Fertilizer Plant), Power Plants and Steel Plants shall also be considered. F) A job executed by a Bidder for their own in-house purpose/sister concern/subsidiary cannot be consider ed as experience for the purpose of meeting BEC. G) If the job was executed as a subcontractor, the bidder should submit the corresponding subcontract wor k order along with completion certificate issued by the main contractor to the subcontractor and also subm it completion certificate issued by the end user to main contractor as a documentary evidence for proof of completion of job. If the bidder is unable to submit the completion certificate from end user to main contra ctor for the executed works, then the bidder must provide end users details (email and phone number etc. ) for verification. RCF will attempt to get confirmation of job execution, directly from end user. If the end u ser does not confirm the execution of the job, the submitted work order shall not be considered for qualific ation. Note: Such requests shall be made a maximum of two times, including one reminder, with the reminder be ing issued after three (03) days from the initial request 2) Average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financi al year (i.e. FY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) should be at least Rs. 2.51 Crores. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken i nto account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial year/ the average financial turnover du ring preceding two financial years should be at least Rs. 2.51 Crores. Bidders shall submit CA certificate / CA audited Profit & Loss accounts, Balance sheets etc. indicating the a nnual turnover figures, in support of the same. The financial documents has to be CA audited/issued with membership number, seal, signed and with UDIN. 3) Ownership of company with name, addresses and telephone nos. of proprietors/ partners/directors. 4) Copy of Partnership deed /proprietorship/ Memorandum and article of association and certificate of incor poration as the case may be. 5) Net worth of the bidder should not be negative on 31.03.2026. It means the net worth of the bidder shou ld not be negative in the balance sheet of financial year 2025-2026. AND

Net worth of the bidder should have not eroded by more than 30% (thirty percent) in the last three years, ending 31.03.2026. It means the net worth of financial year 2025- 2026 should not be less than 70% comp ared to the net worth of financial year 2023- 2024. The bidder to submit the documentary proof e.g. audited balance sheet, P&L account etc. for the same or Net worth Certificate duly certified by practicing CA with membership number, seal, signed and UDIN numb er. In case the date of constitution/ incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the following will be ap plicable: � The Net Worth in each of these years should not be negative. � Net Worth in respect of the immediate previous financial year should not have eroded more 30 per cent t han that of its previously audited financial statement. 6) Shall submit Provident Fund Registration details, ESIC registration details, PAN details and GST details e tc. 7) Submission of Integrity Pact (Annexure-XIV) of NIT with date and sign on each page.
